name: nft-accept-accept-peer-sub-and-later-drop
description: accept-peer with a chain that accepts, below a drop already in place
setup: nft add chain inet f out "{ type filter hook output priority 0; policy accept; }"
nft add chain inet f sub
nft add rule inet f sub ip daddr 10.5.5.2 accept
nft add rule inet f out ip daddr 10.5.5.2 drop

action.spec: nft add rule inet f out ip daddr 10.5.5.2 accept
